transcript: Last night my friend Marie and I went to #UglyCry by Katie Mack #UglyCry is a solo show about grief specifically Mack’s grief about her friend Eric who died a couple of years ago. She maintains connection with Eric through the internet scouring the web to see his photos and writings, she also looks back at the text messages they exchanged. The show uses technology heavily in some really creative ways and audience phone use is encouraged. Some of these choices worked better than others I thought but I generally really liked it because it made me reflect on my connection with the internet as it relates to the legacies of our lives and our relationships. In terms of content, there are elements of this piece that are quite satirical and absurd and that brings a refreshing sense of self awareness to the piece about the somewhat crazy places we go and things we do when we're experiencing grief or trauma. Overall I thought the show was super innovative and entertaining and cool how its structure and use of technology is really intelligently crafted to reflect the story that's told and the emotional roller coaster it induced. I would definitely recommend.
